description: Get Uber H3 cell indices for a polygon (including interior holes), location boundary, or bounding box at a target resolution. When a WKT/GeoJSON polygon or named location boundary is provided, fills the exact polygon geometry (subtracting interior holes) rather than just its bounding rectangle.

bbox.description: The geometry to parse. Can be a raw bounding box string ('lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2'), WKT polygon (with optional holes), GeoJSON polygon/multipolygon, tile 'z/x/y', or ogrinfo extent. Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

compact.description: Whether to return a compacted list of cells (mixing resolutions) to minimize response size. Defaults to false.

location.description: A text location to search for (e.g. 'San Francisco'). Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

resolution.description: The H3 resolution level, from 0 to 15. (e.g. 7)

return_geometry.description: If true, return GeoJSON FeatureCollection with hex boundary polygons in addition to cell IDs. Defaults to false.

summary_only.description: If true, returns only cell count, sample cells, and map share URL without dumping thousands of cell IDs into context. Ideal for high resolutions. Defaults to false.

use_polygon_boundary.description: If true (default), fills the exact WKT/GeoJSON/OSM polygon boundary (including interior holes) instead of its rectangular bounding box when available.

name: get_h3_indices
